[SWS_DM_00150] Primary trigger for event memory entry storage
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04211, RS_Diag_04105
⌈
Creating and storing memory entries (incl. collecting DTC-related data) shall be
triggered according to the
DiagnosticMemoryDestination.memoryEntryStor-
ageTrigger
configuration parameter (see [4]).
⌋
Note that for updating
snapshot record
and extended data information record spe-
cific configuration options are available. For details check the following sections.
